items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: in all the second trumpet I had, him and Russ in love was the best two second trumpet I had.

ctx.x: Yeah that's right. And I'll tell you, in all the second trumpet I had, him and Russ in love was the best two second trumpet I had. He really knows how to play second you know. Well, and uh, so uh, then that was I got uh, that boy, what that boy's name again, this fellow, he's sick now, he's in the record band, played second. Oh yeah. Rodney. Well Rodney played in the Edmund Washington place, you see, after we was working for the railroad. He, well he played with us a long time. So then after that, well, I got…
Who was your favorite second coronet that you ever played with? Well the. When you had two coronets, did you play the lead usually and the other fellow played? Yeah, I played the lead.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Look, I had Charlie Love. You see Charlie Love? That man's a musician.

ctx.x: Alright, same people. The same people. So alright. That's the same thing when we play the move on rules. See? Now we play the move on rules. Sometimes we play three or four nights a week. That, you see? For Spain. Well alright. Now you know I couldn't go there and keep playing that same number over and over. It was impossible to do that. So well, alright. Just like I said, a fella asked me, like you said, well you know such a number? You know what I mean? I don't have it. I don't have it. See? I don't have it.…
See me there? See me standing up here?
